source.description:
Fengtian Discusses Marriage and Money Management

Japanese-born entertainer Fengtian announced his marriage on August 29 and recently joined the financial program "Financial Power" to highlight the contrasts between Taiwanese and Japanese approaches to personal finance. He revealed that he has embraced investing in stocks and funds, often making bold moves without informing his wife to avoid criticism if investments underperform. His wife, valuing traditional Japanese caution, prefers a more conservative strategy, prompting the couple to adopt separate financial management.

Fengtian recounted his initial culture shock upon arriving in Taiwan
